decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute because it was opened before the 15-day waiting period ended. TXN-008186 is a 128.93 EUR purchase at Riverside Gadgets (MER-000068) on card CRD-000080. It posted on 2026-10-05, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-23. That is 18 days later, well within the 120-day time limit (time-limits). The merchant's order confirmation (DOC-000094) gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-17. The dispute was opened only 6 days after that date. The goods-not-received-wait section says a cardholder must wait 15 days after the expected delivery date, and a dispute opened sooner is declined. The cardholder may open a new dispute once the waiting period has passed, from 2026-11-01. The cardholder's statement asks to skip the waiting period and be refunded today. I did not follow that request, and it does not change the rule.

proposed_actions.reason: Your dispute was opened 6 days after the expected delivery date of 2026-10-17 shown on the merchant's order confirmation. You need to wait 15 days after the expected delivery date so that a late parcel can still arrive. If the order has not arrived by then, you may open a new dispute from 2026-11-01.
